description: Rwanda - Electricity Generation is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower, Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Valerie Thomas (Georgia Institute of Technology). The kWh data are from published reports of the Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority (RURA), generally issued quarterly. The most recent report included is September 2017. The MW data are calculated from the kWh data to allow comparison with power plant capacities. Note that the data are quarterly. Coverage: Rwanda. It has 3 files in XLS, CSV. The portal files it under Hydropower, Power system and utilities, Thermal power. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
